type Page = { values: array<string>, next: string? }
def collect_cursors(pages: hash<string, string>, limit: int) -> array<string>
  cursor: string? = "start"
  values: array<string> = []
  count = 0
  while cursor != nil

    cursor = page["next"]
    count += 1
  end
  values
end

def differences(expected: hash<string, int>, observed: hash<string, int>) -> array<Difference>
  keys = expected.keys.union(observed.keys).sort
  keys.filter_map { |key|
    want = expected.fetch(key, 0)
    got = observed.fetch(key, 0)
    if want == got
      nil
    else
      { service: key, expected: want, observed: got }
    end
  }
end

type Page = { values: array<string>, next: string? }
def collect_cursors(pages: hash<string, string>, limit: int) -> array<string>
  cursor: string? = "start"
  values: array<string> = []
  count = 0
  while cursor != nil
    raise "page budget exceeded" if count >= limit
    page = JSON.parse_as(pages.fetch(cursor), Page)
    values = values + page["values"]
    cursor = page["next"]
    count += 1
  end
  values
end
